food_log_items_fibre_range.name: food_log_items_fibre_range
food_log_items_fibre_range.value: ("food_log_items"."fibre_low" IS NULL AND "food_log_items"."fibre_high" IS NULL) OR ("food_log_items"."fibre_low" IS NOT NULL AND "food_log_items"."fibre_high" IS NOT NULL AND "food_log_items"."fibre_low" >= 0 AND "food_log_items"."fibre_low" <= "food_log_items"."fibre_high")

food_nutrition_fibre_range.name: food_nutrition_fibre_range
food_nutrition_fibre_range.value: ("food_nutrition"."fibre_low" IS NULL AND "food_nutrition"."fibre_high" IS NULL) OR ("food_nutrition"."fibre_low" IS NOT NULL AND "food_nutrition"."fibre_high" IS NOT NULL AND "food_nutrition"."fibre_low" >= 0 AND "food_nutrition"."fibre_low" <= "food_nutrition"."fibre_high")

mess_dish_corrections_value.name: mess_dish_corrections_value
mess_dish_corrections_value.value:
CASE
        WHEN "mess_dish_corrections"."field" in ('kcal', 'protein', 'carb', 'fat') THEN "mess_dish_corrections"."value_low" IS NOT NULL AND "mess_dish_corrections"."value_high" IS NOT NULL AND "mess_dish_corrections"."value_low" >= 0 AND "mess_dish_corrections"."value_low" <= "mess_dish_corrections"."value_high" AND "mess_dish_corrections"."diet_value" IS NULL
        WHEN "mess_dish_corrections"."field" = 'diet' THEN "mess_dish_corrections"."diet_value" in ('veg', 'egg', 'nonveg') AND "mess_dish_corrections"."value_low" IS NULL AND "mess_dish_corrections"."value_high" IS NULL
        ELSE "mess_dish_corrections"."note" IS NOT NULL AND "mess_dish_corrections"."value_low" IS NULL AND "mess_dish_corrections"."value_high" IS NULL AND "mess_dish_corrections"."diet_value" IS NULL
      END

mess_dish_nutrition_fibre_range.name: mess_dish_nutrition_fibre_range
mess_dish_nutrition_fibre_range.value: ("mess_dish_nutrition"."fibre_low" IS NULL AND "mess_dish_nutrition"."fibre_high" IS NULL) OR ("mess_dish_nutrition"."fibre_low" IS NOT NULL AND "mess_dish_nutrition"."fibre_high" IS NOT NULL AND "mess_dish_nutrition"."fibre_low" >= 0 AND "mess_dish_nutrition"."fibre_low" <= "mess_dish_nutrition"."fibre_high")
